title: Left F119 Low-Observable Augmentor (Afterburner)
summary: Three-zone low-observable afterburner with fuel injectors integrated into thick curved radar-blocking vanes.
role: Provides full afterburning thrust augmentation while shielding hot turbine blades from rear radar and IR detection.
materials: High-temperature ceramic-matrix and superalloy thermal liners.
